content: Taabotey Xoossa Keethi Gelis

Hessafe guye, kawoy Solomoney Godaa taabotiya Dawita katamaape, Xiyoonepe kessidi, Xoossa keethi ehanaw Isra7eele cimata, kochata halaqatanne Isra7eele soo asata kaaletheyisata Yerusalaame kataman shiishis.
Etaanima geetetiya laapuntha ageenan, Shaqara Ba7aaley bonchetiya wode Isra7eele asa ubbay kawa Solomoneko shiiqidosona.
Isra7eele cimati ubbay shiiqin, kahineti Taabotiya denthidosona.
Leewetinne kahineti, Godaa taabotiya, Dunkaaniyanne iya giddon de7iya geeshsha miisheta ubbaa tookidi ehidosona.
Kawoy Solomoneynne iyara de7iya Isra7eele asay Taabotiya sinthan shiiqidi, taybanaw danda7etonna daro dorsenne mehe yarshidosona.
Hessafe guye, kahineti Godaa caaqo taabotiya Xoossa keethan Ubbaafe Geeshsha bessa ehidi, kiruubeta qefetape garsa baggara wothidosona.
Micetidi uttida kiruubeta qefeti taabotiyanne taabotiya tookiya kasota kammidosona.
Kasoti daro adusse gidiya gisho enta xeeray Ubbaafe Geeshsha Bessa sinthan qoncen bentoosona. Shin Geeshsha bessaafe karera bentanaw danda7enna. Enti hachi gakanaw he bessan de7oosona.
Isra7eele asay Gibxe biittafe keyida wode Goday entara caaqida Koreeba zuman Musey wothida nam7u loche shuchata xalaalape attishin, Taabotiya giddon harabay aybika baawa.
Kahineti Xoossa keethafe keyida wode Xoossa keethay shaaran kumis.
He shaara gaason kahineti banta oosuwa oothanaw danda7ibookona; Godaa bonchoy Xoossa keetha kumis.
Hessafe guye, Solomoney, “Abeeti Godaw, neeni, ‘Taani dhuma shaaran daana’ yaagadasa.
Taani new boncho keethi, merinaw neeni yan daana bessi keexas” yaagis.
Isra7eele maabaray kumethi yan eqidashin, kawoy entako simmidi, haysada yaagidi entaw woossis.
“Goday Isra7eele Xoossay galatetto! Ta aawa Dawitas ba doonan odida ufaysa qaala ba kushen polis. I odida ufaysa qaalay,

‘Taani ta asaa, Isra7eele Gibxefe kessida gallasape doomin, ta sunthay iyan daana mela keethe keexanaw Isra7eele kochata giddon issi katamaka doorabike. Shin ta asaa Isra7eele kaalethana mela taani Dawita dooras’ yaagis.
“Ta aaway Dawiti, Godaa Isra7eele Xoossaa sunthaas keethe keexanaw ba wozanan qopis.
Shin Goday, ta aawa Dawitako, ‘Neeni ta sunthaas keethe keexanaw ne wozanan qopida gisho lo77oba oothadasa.
Gidoshin, keethe keexanay nena gidaka; ta sunthaas keethe keexanay ne gulbatape yeletana ne na7aa’ yaagis.
“Goday gelida ba ufaysa qaala polis. Goday kase gelida ufaysa qaalada taani ta aawa Dawita bessan kawotas; Isra7eele kawotetha araatan uttas. Godaa Isra7eele Xoossaa sunthaas keethe keexas.
Goday nu aawata Gibxefe kessida wode entara caaqida caaqo taabotiya wothana bessi giigisas” yaagis.
Solomone Woosaa
Hessafe guye, Solomoney Godaa yarsho bessa sinthan, kumetha Isra7eele maabara giddon eqidi, ba kushiya miccidi,

haysada yaagidi woossis; “Abeeti Godaw, Isra7eele Xoossaw, bolla saluwan garsa sa7an ne mela xoossi baawa. Neeni ne caaquwa naagasa. Ba kumetha wozanan ne sinthan hemetiya ne aylleta ne merinaa siiquwan dosadasa.
Ne aylliyas, ta aawa Dawitas, neeni oothana gada gelida qaala naagadasa. Neeni kase ne doonan odidaysa hachi ne kushen poladasa.

“Ha77ika Godaw, Isra7eele Xoossaw, neeni ne aylliyas, ta aawa Dawitas, ‘Neeni ta sinthan hemetidaysada ne naytika ta sinthan hemetidi banta ogiya naagiko, ta sinthan Isra7eele kawotetha araatan uttiya asi neeni dhayaka’ yaagida qaala pola.
Abeeti Isra7eele Xoossaw, neeni ne aylliyas, ta aawa Dawitas gelida ne qaala ha77ika pola.
“Shin Xoossay tuma sa7an daaneyee? Heko, saloti, ubbaafe dhoqa saloyka nena oykanaw danda7enna. Yaatin, taani keexida keethay new ay mela guuxandesha!
Gidoshin, abeeti Godaw, ta Xoossaw, taani ne aylley hachi woossiya woosanne waasuwa si7a.
‘Ta sunthay he bessan daana’ gida ha keethaa ne ayfey qammanne gallas xeello. Taani ne aylley ha bessaako simmada woossiya woosa si7a.
Taani ne aylleynne ne asay Isra7eeley, ha Xoossa keethaako simmidi, woossiya woosa si7a. Ne de7iya bessan salon si7ada nuus atto yaaga.
“Issi asi ba laggiya qohidi, qohabike gidi kaddin, iya caaqisanaw Xoossa keethi ehin, iya giddon de7iya yarsho bessa sinthan I caaqiko,
neeni salon si7ada ootha. Ne aylleta giddon pirda. Naaqida uraa bolla pirdada, I oothidaba iya bolla zaara; xilluwas pirdada iya xillotethaa qoncisa.
“Ne asay Isra7eeley ne bolla nagara oothida gisho banta morketan xoonetidi, neeko simmidi ne sunthaa xeegiko, ha keethan nena woossikonne neeko waassiko,
neeni salon si7a. Ne asaa Isra7eele nagaraa atto ga; yaatada neeni kase enta mayzatas immida biitta enta guye zaara.
“Ne asay ne bolla nagara oothida gisho saloy gordetin, iri bukonna ixin, enti ha bessaa simmidi, woossikonne neeni enta un7ethida gisho ne sunthaa xeegidi, banta nagaraape simmiko neeni salon si7a.
Ne aylleta, Isra7eele nagaraa atto ga. Enti hemetanaw bessiya lo77o ogiya enta tamaarsa; ne asaa laatisida biittan ira bukisa.
“Biitta bolla koshi woyko gadoy yaa wode, carkoy kathaa shocidi woyko harmey dhaysiya wode, booley woyko gumburoy biitta bolla yaa wode, morkey enta katamata teqiya wode, gadoynne hargey yaa wode,
ne asa Isra7eelepe oonika nena woossikonne neeko waassiko qassi ay asika ba wozanan un7etidi ha Xoossa keethaako simmidi ba kushiya micciko,
ne de7iya bessan salon si7a. Enta nagaraa atto ga; enta maadda. Neeni asa wozana ereysada asa ubbaas iya oosuwada oosuwada imma. Asa ubbaa wozana erey ne xalaala.
Yaaniko, neeni nu mayzatas immida biittan de7iya wode ubban enti new yayyana.
“Ne asaa Isra7eelepe gidonashin, allaga biitta asay, ne gita sunthaa gisho haaho biittafe yida asi de7iko,
ne gita sunthaa si7idi, haaho biittafe yidi, ha Xoossa keethaako simmidi nena woossiko,

neeni de7iya bessan salon si7a. Ne asati, Isra7eeleti ereysada sa7an de7iya asa ubbay ne sunthaa erana melanne new yayyana mela, taani keexida ha Xoossa keethay nena goyinniya bessi gideysa enti erana mela allaga biitta asay woossiyaba entaw pola.
“Ne asati banta morketa olana mela ne kiitida bessaa bidi, enti neeni doorida ha katamaakonne taani ne sunthaas keexida keethaako simmidi Godaa nena woossiko,
enta woosanne waasuwa salon si7ada entaw xoono imma.
“Nagara oothonna asi bayna gisho enti ne bolla nagara oothin, neeni enta hanqetada morketas aathada immin, morketi enta di77idi, haaho gidin mata bessi efikoka,
enti he di7etida biittan de7ishe, banta wozanan nagarape simmiko, he di7etida biittan de7ishe, ‘Nuuni nagara oothida; nuuni balida; nuuni iita hanida’ yaagidi neeko waassiko,

entana di77idi efida morketa biittan de7ishe, banta kumetha wozananinne banta kumetha qofan neeko simmiko, neeni enta mayzatas immida enta biittako, ne doorida katamaakonne taani ne sunthaas keexida keethaako simmidi, nena woossiko,
enta woosanne enta waasuwa ne de7iya bessan salon si7ada entaw pirda.
Ne asay ne bolla oothida nagaraanne qohida qohuwa atto ga; enta di77idi efida asati entaw qadhetana mela ootha.
Enti, birata seerisiya cooce tamada xuuggiya Gibxe biittafe neeni kessida ne asatanne ne buzo laatata.
“Taani ne aylleynne ne asay Isra7eeley woossiya woosa ne ayfey xeello. Enti waassiya wode awudeka neeni enta alla.
Abeeti Godaw, Xoossaw, neeni kase nu aawata Gibxefe kessiya wode ne aylliya Muse baggara odidaysada enta sa7an de7iya kawotethata ubbaa giddofe new buzo oothanaw dummayida dere” yaagidi woossis.
Solomoney woosa polidaape guye, ba kushiya miccidi yarsho bessa sinthan gulbatida bessaafe dendi eqis.
Isra7eele maabara ubbaa ba qaala dhoqu oothidi haysada yaagidi anjis;
“Ba gelida qaalada ba asa Isra7eele shempisida Goday galatetto; I ba aylliya Muse baggara immida lo77o ufaysa qaala ubbay poletis.
Goday nu Xoossay kase nu aawatara de7idaysada nuuraka de7o; I nuna kumethi aggenna; yeggenna.
Nuuni iya ogetan hemetana melanne I nu aawatas immida kiitaanne wogaa naagana mela nu wozanaa baako zaaro.
Gallas gallas nuus koshshiyaba immanaw Goday tana ba aylliyanne ba asaa Isra7eele maaddana mela, taani Godaa sinthan woossida woosati qammanne gallas Godaako, nu Xoossaako, shiiqo.
Hessan, sa7an de7iya asa ubbay Goday Xoosse gideysanne iyape attishin, hara xoossi baynaysa erana.
Hachi hinte oothidaysada hinte iya wogaada iyaw kiitetanaw hinte wozanay Godaas, nu Xoossaas ammaneteysa gido” yaagidi anjis.
Xoossa Keetha Anjiso
Hessafe guye kawoynne Isra7eele asa ubbay issife Godaa sinthan yarsho yarshidosona.
Solomoney Godaas issifetetha yarsho yarshanaw 22,000 booratanne 120,000 dorsata shiishis. Hessada oothidi kawoynne Isra7eele asa ubbay Godaa keethaa anjisidosona.

Kawoy Solomoney Xoossa keetha sinthan de7iya dabaaba giddo kifiliya he gallas dummayis. He bessan xuussa yarsho, katha yarshonne issifetetha yarshuwafe modhuwa yarshis. I hessa oothiday Godaa sinthan de7iya naase biratape oosetida yarsho bessay xuussa yarsho, katha yarshonne issifetetha yarshuwafe modhuwa yarshanaw guuxida gishosa.

He wode Solomoneynne Isra7eele asa ubbay laapun gallas Shaqara Ba7aale bonchidosona; Isra7eele zawan Hamaata Pinuwape bidi Gibxe shaafa gakanaw de7iya daro asay Godaa sinthan ba7aale bonchanaw shiiqis.
Wontetha gallas kawoy asaa moyzis; asay kawa anjidi, Goday ba aylliya Dawitasinne ba asaa Isra7eeles oothida keehatethan wozanape ufaytishe ba soo ba soo bis.
